stages.title: Learn the Basics
stages.milestone: Create a database and inspect its tables and stored values.

stages.title: Learn SQL and Database Design
stages.milestone: Design a constrained relational schema and write useful queries.

stages.title: Manage Data Reliably
stages.milestone: Implement a multi-table workflow that commits atomically or rolls back.

stages.title: Improve Query Performance
stages.milestone: Improve a query with repeatable measurements and query-plan evidence.

stages.title: Integrate SQLite into Applications
stages.milestone: Build safe data access with prepared statements and controlled transactions.

stages.title: Prepare for Production
stages.milestone: Demonstrate restore, integrity, migration and error-handling procedures.

stages.title: Master Advanced Features
stages.milestone: Implement one specialized feature and document runtime dependencies.

stages.title: Test, Deploy and Build a Complete Product
stages.milestone: Deliver a documented capstone with tests, migration and recovery evidence.

dependencies.requires: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and error handling
Transactions, application architecture and change tracking
